glyph.isekai_mahou.king_crimson.desc: Effect (tribute to JoJo). Erases time. On you (Self): a short scene, then for 4 s (Extend +, up to 10 s) time vanishes around you — the world keeps moving, but you are invisible, nobody targets you and everything passes through you (you can't hurt anyone either). Everyone within 16 blocks (Expand +, up to 24; not bosses) gets a red X on the ground near them that ONLY YOU can see. When time resumes, everyone appears on their X at once with a different item in hand (another hotbar slot/another loadout; creatures swap hands) — and you're already in position: your first hit within 3 s deals ×1.5 and you see the Epitaph of nearby enemies. On an enemy: its time vanishes for 2 s (bosses 1/3, players up to 2.5 s) — it moves on autopilot, can't target and its attacks never happen.
glyph.isekai_mahou.epitaph.desc: Augment (tribute to JoJo). Whoever the spell hurts is FORESEEN for 6 s (the effect's Extend +): you see the line of where it is going and, if it comes for you, the red line of the attack and which side it comes from. Its first attack on you is dodged with a sidestep.
glyph.isekai_mahou.bites_the_dust.desc: Effect (tribute to JoJo). Plants an 8 s bomb (Extend +, up to 20 s) on something or someone (creature, block or yourself) and saves the position of everyone near it (16 blocks, Expand +) and yours. When the bomb goes off: a cutscene and everyone goes back to where they were — you go back to the health you had (plus hunger and some mana), allies regain health up to that moment, enemies only go back in place. The same time later, the target explodes: 10 × power damage to it and 3 × power to enemies within 3 blocks (bomb on you: it explodes on the nearest enemy). If you were going to DIE with the fuse lit, time rewinds right away (once every 2 min). Same dimension and arena only; bosses don't move; never breaks blocks or undoes deaths or items.
glyph.isekai_mahou.killer_queen.desc: Fire effect (tribute to JoJo). Whatever it touches becomes a bomb. Creature: explodes after 3 s (Extend +) or when you hit it again — 9 damage to it and 4.5 around (radius 2.5; Expand +). Block: a 20 s mine that blows when an enemy comes close (small crater only where terrain destruction is allowed). On you (Self): the block you look at becomes the mine. Up to 3 bombs at once; nothing explodes in cities.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sheer_heart_attack.de: Fire form (tribute to JoJo). Releases a little skull tank that drives along the ground hunting the HOTTEST enemy within 24 blocks (burning > fire creatures > players > the rest). On contact it explodes, applying the spell's effects, and keeps hunting: 3 explosions (Split +1 each, up to 6) or 15 s (Extend +). Accelerate = faster. Indestructible; one at a time; stays calm in Peace Mode and in cities.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ora_rush.desc: Effect (tribute to JoJo). A guardian spirit unleashes a punch barrage: 7 quick punches (1 damage each) and a stronger last one (3) that sends the target flying. On you (Self): punches the nearest enemy in front of you (up to 5 blocks). Stops if you move too far away.
glyph.isekai_mahou.boost_gear.desc: Augment (tribute to High School DxD's Boost Gear). "Boost!": casting the spell again within 2.5 s (or keeping it channelled) doubles the bonus each step — ×1 → ×1.25 → ×1.5 → ×2 → ×3. Cap by Circle (C1–3: ×1.5; C4–5: ×2; C6+: ×3). Stopping for 2.5 s resets it. +0.25 s cast time.
glyph.isekai_mahou.boost_transfer.desc: Beneficial effect (tribute to High School DxD). Hands over the built-up power: the target (an ally or you) gets "Transfer!" for 15 s (Extend +) — +15% damage per level, melee and spells. Level = 1 + your current Boost step + Amplify (max 5). The giver drops back to step zero.
glyph.isekai_mahou.balance_breaker.desc: Beneficial Fire effect (tribute to High School DxD). Dons the Red Dragon's Scale Mail for 20 s (Extend +; ×1.5 if you are at Boost step 2+): +8 armor, +4 toughness, +3 attack, +10% speed and half knockback immunity. When it ends, Weakness for 5 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.full_cowl.desc: Beneficial effect (tribute to My Hero Academia). One For All flows through the whole body for 30 s (Extend +): speed, strength, jump and safe falls, stronger the higher the percentage. Starts at your Circle's SAFE percentage (C1–3 5%, C4 8%, C5 15%, C6 20%, C7 30%, C8+ 45%); each Amplify climbs one step (up to 100%). Above safe, the body slowly breaks (damage every 2 s, never lethal; at 25% health it drops back to safe with a broken arm).
glyph.isekai_mahou.one_for_all.desc: Augment (tribute to My Hero Academia). Puts a percentage of One For All into the spell: 1 copy = 20%, 2 = 45%, 3 = 100% — power ×1.3 / ×1.68 / ×2.5. Above your Circle's safe percentage (+10% with Full Cowl), the body breaks after the spell: self-damage (never lethal) and a broken arm (Weakness and Mining Fatigue). With Detroit Smash at 100%: United States of Smash.
glyph.isekai_mahou.delaware_smash.desc: Wind effect (tribute to My Hero Academia). A finger flick that becomes air pressure: 4 damage and a HUGE push away from you (bosses barely move). On you (Self): "Air Force" — the air bullet flies where you look (20 blocks) and hits the first 3 enemies on its path.
glyph.isekai_mahou.detroit_smash.desc: Wind effect (tribute to My Hero Academia). The punch that makes the wind: 8 damage to the target, which is launched up and away, and the shockwave hits nearby enemies (radius 3; Expand +) for half. With One For All at 100% it becomes the UNITED STATES OF SMASH: double radius, ×1.5 damage and the ground shakes. On you (Self): the punch blows up 3 blocks ahead. Doesn't break blocks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.blackwhip.desc: Shadow effect (tribute to My Hero Academia). Black tendrils burst from your arm: an enemy hit is PULLED to you (bosses are only slowed), takes 2 damage and Slowness III for 2 s. On a block: you pull yourself to it like a grappling hook and fall slowly for 3 s. On you (Self): the whip goes where you look — pulls the first enemy (20 blocks) or takes you to the block (24 blocks).
glyph.isekai_mahou.psycho_hundred.desc: Effect (tribute to Mob Psycho 100). Emotion turns into psychic power: the target is LIFTED into the air and 0.7 s later SLAMMED into the ground (damage 4 + 0.05 × emotion). Emotion is the health you have already lost (10% to 100%); at 25% health or less it overflows — "???%": ×1.4 damage, bigger area, and you pass out a bit later (slow and weak for 6 s). Bosses aren't lifted. On you (Self): bursts around you (up to 10 enemies).
glyph.isekai_mahou.genki_dama.desc: Augment (tribute to Dragon Ball's Genki Dama). Raise your hands (+1.5 s cast): the spell gathers energy from living beings within 32 blocks — allies 3, pets 2, animals and villagers 1 (max 30) — power ×(1 + 0.05 per point), up to ×2.5, and +50% area. It doesn't hurt the pure of heart: the spell only hits ENEMIES.
glyph.isekai_mahou.cursed_speech.desc: Shadow effect (tribute to Jujutsu Kaisen). Words carrying cursed energy. Normal: "DON'T MOVE!" — the target is stunned for 1.5 s (Extend +; bosses 1/3). With Amplify: "BLAST AWAY!" — 6 damage and a push. The price is your throat: after speaking you are Silenced (1.5 s; 3 s for Blast) and lose half a heart (never lethal). On you (Self): every enemy within 8 blocks hears it (up to 8).

message.isekai_mahou.legends_h.time_resu: Time flows again. Only you remember.

message.isekai_mahou.legends_h.rewind_de: Bites the Dust! Death was undone — time rewound.

message.isekai_mahou.legends_h.btd_armed: Killer Queen: the target explodes in %s s
message.isekai_mahou.legends_h.kc_marked: %s destinations marked — only you see the X.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_h.scale_mai: The Scale Mail fades... your body feels heavy.

message.isekai_mahou.legends_h.cowl_brok: Your body can't take it! Full Cowl drops to %s%%.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_h.ofa_broke: One For All %s%% (safe: %s%%) — your arm broke!
